deadline.value: The LSM 2026/27 call closed 26 October 2026 at 12:00 noon CET. The page ties it to the 2026/27 cohort, not an autumn 2027 start, so no Fall 2027 deadline is recorded.
deadline.quote: extended until 26 October, 12:00 noon CET: Deadline for submitting the applications

gre_subject.value: The LSM page mentions no subject GRE test.

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to choose a recruiting lab before applying, since doctoral positions are offered within labs.
supervisor.quote: Interested in joining an LSM lab? The recruiting labs are online

funding.value: Successful applicants are offered a doctoral position that is generally funded through supervisors' research funds or scholarships.
funding.quote: Successful applicants will be offered a doctoral position, which is generally funded through the supervisor's third-party research funds or scholarships

entry_route.value: A master's degree (MSc) or German Diplom is expected; a 4-year bachelor's with honours is considered only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree (MSc) or German university Diploma

app_fee.value: The LSM states that it charges no application or tuition fee, which differs from the university record.
app_fee.quote: There are no application or tuition fees.

gre_general.value: Applicants from non-EU countries, including India, are strongly advised to submit a GRE test.
gre_general.quote: Applicants from non-EU countries are strongly advised to submit a GRE test

english_waiver.value: A TOEFL or IELTS certificate is strongly recommended but not compulsory; the requirement is waived only for native speakers or applicants whose whole education was in English.
english_waiver.quote: A language certificate is not required if you

also.quote: Completed your entire education in English

notes: Umbrella school covering biochemistry, cell biology, genetics, human biology, bioinformatics, molecular biology, microbiology, neuroscience, plant science and zoology, so neuro is listed as also_fields. Applications run through the online LSM portal; the page says decisions come in late February and a 2026/27 call closed 26 October 2026. The individual doctorate in the Faculty of Biology was not reached: the Dekanat PDF info_docstud_bio22 returned 404.
